newsitem.title: CHINA: TABLE-Shanghai Automation H1 net down.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Shanghai Automation H1 net down.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures) Turnover 505.537 vs 526.153
Net asset per share 2.12 yuan vs 2.12 yuan
Earnings per share 0.0583 yuan vs 0.08 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Automation Instrumentation Co Ltd.
Note: The results were contained in a company statement in the Shanghai Securities News on Friday.

The figures are unaudited, as Chinese securities rules do not require listed firms to have their interim results audited. Trading in the company's A and B shares would be suspended on Friday morning and would resume in the afternoon.
